title: Figure 9: Su/+ tobacco leaf showing dark green and pale mutation spots
description: Close-up color photograph of a pale green tobacco leaf surface with a large dark green patch and an adjacent pale yellowish patch, illustrating the color-spot result of a mutagenic assay. The caption reads "Figure 9 - Su/+ tobacco plants exhibiting mutations in both alleles." It appears in the "Scientific Analysis" section describing biosensor plants (Spiderwort and Tobacco) placed at a ranch on April 6, 2010, with researcher names redacted as "AAP Person" labels.
